crime: {WITCH_NAME}'s mother used to come home every weekend. As her visits grew rarer, her parcels grew bigger. The last one held a hand-knitted sweater, and after it she never came again. The bigger the gift, the nearer the goodbye. That night {WITCH_NAME} used her Magic to renounce sweaters. Not one has touched her since, and every evening she shivers.

In the lounge, one prisoner knits beside the fireplace every evening, the way her grandmother taught her, while {WITCH_NAME} holds the skein for her. She has been knitting a scarf because {WITCH_NAME} shivers without a sweater. When it is finished, she knots it around {WITCH_NAME}'s neck and says that tomorrow she'll start one for each of the others.
That evening, in front of everyone, {WITCH_NAME} renounces scarves. The scarf slides off her neck and curls away across the floor.

The next evening the girl sits knitting the first of the others' scarves, a scarf of her own around her neck. {WITCH_NAME} steps up behind her and cups both hands around the back of that scarf, close to the wool but never touching it. She holds them there until the girl stops moving.

The prisoners find her strangled on the lounge sofa, her own scarf knotted at her throat. In the trial court they rule {WITCH_NAME} out: they all saw that no scarf can come near her, so someone else must have pulled it tight. Then one prisoner notices that the scarf's ends hang smooth, never gripped, while its back is sunk deep into the nape of the girl's neck. Nobody pulled it. The scarf pulled itself tight, straining forward to get away from {WITCH_NAME}'s hands at the back of the girl's neck.
fields.epitaph: Only the cold never said goodbye.
execution: An iron slab rises beneath an iron hand holding a stack of parcels. She is chained to the slab on her back, arms spread out as if to receive them. The hand lowers and sets an iron parcel on her chest. Then another, and another, each bigger than the last. Under the biggest parcel she lies still. The iron hand rises and never comes back.

magic.name: Never Again
magic.text: She can banish any one kind of thing or creature from ever coming near her.
